name: n10
description: 10 question(s) spread over the models (prefix of one seeded round-robin order, so smaller sets are nested in larger ones)

questions.question:
Model fantasy_residential_building_1.ifc. How many doors are there in the building?
Answer with an integer.

questions.item: room number such as A102 (drop any -M suffix)
questions.question:
Model duplex_mep.ifc. In which rooms are the main electrical panels located?
Answer with a JSON list of strings, one room number such as A102 (drop any -M suffix) per entry; order does not matter.

questions.question:
Model fantasy_hotel_1.ifc. What heating systems are installed?
A. A heat pump on the 'Mumti' roof level
B. Underfloor heating
C. Cannot be determined from the model
D. Radiators in each guest room, fed by a gas boiler
Answer with the letter (A, B, C or D) of the one correct option.

Model fzk_house.ifc. What is the total length of the exterior walls?
Answer with a number in m; answers within ±0.5 m count as correct.

Model fantasy_office_building_1.ifc. What is the total volume of all floor slabs combined?
A. 1370.3 m³
B. 577.4 m³
C. 351.2 m³
D. 190.1 m³
Answer with the letter (A, B, C or D) of the one correct option.

questions.question:
Model duplex_arc.ifc. What volume of concrete do the wall footings of the foundation need?
A. Cannot be determined from the model
B. About 32.3 m³
C. About 16.5 m³ over the 7 wall footings
D. About 48.8 m³
Answer with the letter (A, B, C or D) of the one correct option.

Model fantasy_office_building_2.ifc. What is the building's footprint area?
A. 1767.3 m²
B. 360.0 m²
C. 716.1 m²
D. 327.4 m²
Answer with the letter (A, B, C or D) of the one correct option.

Model ac20.ifc. Which authoring application exported this IFC file?

Model 4351.ifc. What is the total length of the interior (non-external) walls?
